exam_scheme.note: APTET is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) by the Department of School Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh, adhering to NCTE norms. Paper-I (A & B) qualifies candidates for teaching Classes I to V (Secondary Grade Teacher / SGT), while Paper-II (A & B) qualifies candidates for Classes VI to VIII (School Assistant / SA). Each paper comprises 150 multiple choice questions carrying 150 marks with no negative marking. A 20% weightage of APTET marks is accorded in the AP Teacher Recruitment Test (DSC).
